title: Remote signer over a unix socket
spec: A signer that lives in another process so the venue client never holds a seed. Add src/identity/remote-signer.ts: serveSigner(signer: Signer, socketPath: string): Promise<{ close(): Promise<void> }> and connectSigner(socketPath, expectedDid): Promise<Signer>. Protocol: newline-delimited JSON, request { id, canonical }, reply { id, sig } or { id, error }. The server signs anything for its one DID; the client checks the reply's signature verifies against expectedDid before returning it. Node net only, no dependencies. Socket file mode 0600.
done: A message signed through connectSigner verifies against the served DID and the client refuses a server with the wrong DID.
